thread:
raj: Heads up — support intake from last 48h: three customers asked for API changes. Quick summary:
- QuillHealth: needs streaming chat completions + partial structured outputs (they parse JSON as it streams and are seeing broken objects).
- AcmeCorp: function-calling reliability; duplicate function calls after client retry on long responses.
- Shopr: wants finer control over streaming chunk sizes and a 'prune_kv_cache' toggle.
Can we triage and agree scope? :eyes:

emma: Thanks. Can you paste the ticket excerpts and any repro logs? Which ones are P0?

raj: Pasting short excerpts:
QuillHealth: "parser fails when streaming emits partial JSON with unmatched braces; we need either chunk-aligned JSON objects or a clear 'object_end' signal."
AcmeCorp: "function call invoked twice after client retry when result >8k tokens. trace: acme/trace/9321"
Shopr: lower ARR, not urgent.

cheng: Quick technical take: we don't currently guarantee JSON object boundaries when streaming. Options:
1) server-buffer until full JSON object emitted (adds latency, may be unacceptable)
2) emit chunks with metadata (e.g., chunk_meta {object_end: true}) so clients know when an object is complete
3) provide an 'emit_partial' boolean + client helper lib to reassemble safely.
Effort estimate: (1) high risk/complex; (2) medium (1-2 sprints); (3) low effort (1 sprint + SDK work).

maria: Acme is enterprise and will escalate. If (2) is feasible quickly, they'll take it; may fund work.

emma: Proposed product approach:
- Short term (MVP): implement option (2): add 'chunk_meta' with 'object_end' boolean and document as experimental.
- Mid term: SDK helpers + opt-in buffer mode for enterprise customers (option 1).
Acceptance criteria for MVP:
- QuillHealth parser test passes against the experimental flag
- Acme replay shows <5% duplication on function calls for sampled traffic
- Feature gated per-tenant with rollout controls

cheng: I'll spin up an engineering spike to validate perf impact of adding chunk metadata and small server-side state. If spike looks good, dev + QA about 2 sprints.

raj: I'll attach the original support tickets and customer quotes to the GH issue. QuillHealth is ok to try experimental flag.

ops-bot: Created issue PROD-7891 in eng-runtime: "streaming: chunk_meta + object_end flag" — https://gh.company/eng-runtime/issues/7891

emma: Next steps: cheng — run spike and post findings by EOD Thursday. maria — confirm Acme willingness to fund/enable tenant flag. raj — consolidate backlog items and mark P0/P1. I'll add the MVP to next roadmap sync and prepare launch criteria.

maria: pinging Acme legal + PO now, will update here.

raj: added ticket links to PROD-7891 and a summary doc with repros.

cheng: starting spike now; will post perf numbers and a short design sketch in the issue when ready.

emma: Appreciate it. If spike shows >200ms median overhead we need to revisit scope (maybe limit to enterprise only).

raj: noted. I'll scope a small test harness for QuillHealth to run against the experimental flag.

emma: Great. Closing this thread for now — will surface in roadmap doc after spike results. :white_check_mark:
